pages.en:
Extract from the Shanghai Municipal Police
Police Orders dated November 16, 1930.

No. C. 2367

Copies of all reports concerning the matters
mentioned below will be forwarded to the Officer in charge
of the Special Branch and should reach Headquarters at the
same time as the Daily State.

(1) Arrest of persons on political or quasi political
charges.

(2) Reports of Political demonstrations, strikes,
agitation connected with labour and social unrest.

(3) Irregular arrests by Chinese Authorities.

(4) Disputes between Settlement and Chinese Authorities
of any kind.

(5) Other matters of interest to Special Branch.

The reports should be as full and complete
as possible and be accompanied by literature, handbills
or posters whenever these are available.

When there is insufficient time to comply
with the above order and to avoid unnecessary delay
the Officer in Charge of the Special Branch should be
communicated with by telephone.

Detectives will seek and transmit information
on the above mentioned matters at all times.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. RLC.S... / D.D. 8/12. / 10 - 4 - 31.）
（批：13）

摘自上海公共租界工部局警务处
1930年11月16日发布的警务命令。

编号 C. 2367

所有涉及下述事项的报告副本，均须送交特别处（Special Branch）主管警官，并应与《每日治安状况报告》（Daily State）同时送达总部。

(1) 因政治或类政治罪名逮捕人员。

(2) 关于政治示威、罢工、与劳工及社会动荡相关的煽动活动的报告。

(3) 中国当局进行的违规逮捕。

(4) 租界当局与中国当局之间发生的各类纠纷。

(5) 其他特别处关注的事项。

报告应尽可能详尽完整，并在获取到相关文献、传单或海报时，一并附呈。

若时间紧迫，无法遵守上述命令，为避免不必要的延误，应以电话方式联系特别处主管警官。

警探应随时搜集并报送有关上述事项的情报。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. RLC.S... / D.D. 8/12. / 10 - 4 - 31.）
（批：13）
